description: Takeover round 1 (docs/human_takeover_r1.md): the frozen baseline grounding_film fine-tuned with the corrections a human made while it flew (takeover mode, docs/human_pilot_mode.md), mixed with the data it was trained on. A first round of DAgger: the corrections were made at the states this checkpoint reached, and a passed checkpoint flies the next round's takeover flights.
status_note: A draft until the user agrees to it. Then the pilot, gate and regression starts are drawn and the gate's file sealed (its sha256 written here), and no number of this file changes before the decision.
start_checkpoint_why: the takeover flights were flown with it: every correction is at a state it reached (on-policy). It is the frozen baseline (outputs/generalization/grounding_film_frozen.json). The generic landing chain (stages 1b-1d) passed no gate and its data comes from another teacher.
collected_with: the takeover launcher's default checkpoint (the same grounding_film); flights taken over from another checkpoint (-Checkpoint) are not used in this round

data_gate.description: Training does not start before the kept takeover flights (datasets/projectairsim_visual_search/takeover/episodes) reach every line, and the user says to start. scripts/human_data_status.py shows where the data stands.
data_gate.kinds_from: src/human_pilot/session.surface_kind; random mode (R) draws the five kinds of flight equally often
data_gate.also_used: the human pilot's own flights (datasets/projectairsim_visual_search/human_pilot/episodes): counted apart, trained with the takeover flights in the same share

dataset.name: human_r1
dataset.replay_from: the sources grounding_film was trained on (its manifest: generalization_v3c, 1160 episodes, 57329 samples)
dataset.not_used_why: labels of another teacher, from a chain that passed no gate; left out, the effect of the human data is the one thing that changes
dataset.left_out: as recorded: decisions marked model, handover, pause, below_safe, backward, over_bound are in no label window (scripts/build_visual_search_dataset.py)
dataset.frozen_list: when training starts, the ids and sha256 of every human flight used are written to outputs/human_r1/data_manifest.json

fine_tune.description: Stage 1b's way of training from the same checkpoint: LoRA, action head and FiLM trained; nothing added.
fine_tune.share_from: stage 1b gave its new data 0.45 of the draws from this checkpoint

offline.description: Reported, judging nothing: on the validation flights of the human data, how far the first action of grounding_film and of each candidate is from the human's label (train_aerovla_oft.py --breakdown --source takeover), by phase: far from the object, near it, over its top.

evaluation.layouts_why: the layouts every check is flown in; the human pilot refuses them, so no human flight saw these arrangements. A landing on the plate flies in their plate variants (t_cap ...), built as the recording ones are.
evaluation.keeps_away_from: every check start of the repository (src/human_pilot/session.check_starts), every human flight's start in both datasets, and each other
evaluation.landing: the surface evaluator's landing (stable_physical_landing: the named surface, its region, soft, standing), and precise: within src/human_pilot/session.precision_m of the middle (1.75 m; 1.3 m on the plate)
evaluation.air_stop: a landing flight that ends with the policy's own stop above the surface or the ground
evaluation.repeat_rule: a start whose result flips a pass line by one or two flights is flown a second time by both checkpoints, and both flights count (flights from the same start can end differently)

pilot.description: 32 new starts. grounding_film flies them first, then each candidate once.
pilot.selection: the candidates that meet every line are ranked by `order`; the first goes on. None meets them: round 1 is not passed and no gate is flown.

gate.description: 48 new starts, drawn and sealed when the plan is fixed; flown once by the chosen candidate and by grounding_film, never used for training, the choice or debugging.

regression.description: What grounding_film was made for: 24 new pad landings 12-44 m away in the evaluation layouts.

decision: Round 1 passes only if the data gate was met, a candidate passed the pilot, the gate and the regression. A passed checkpoint is saved as outputs/aerovla_oft/checkpoints/human_r1 and flies round 2's takeover flights. Not passed: the data stays, the reasons are reported, and the next step is the user's decision.
not_done: no file of the frozen baseline changes
the canonical evaluation, its maps and the 44 m canonical test are not changed or reused
the sealed gates of stage 1c stay unopened
nothing starts on its own: training starts when the data gate is met and the user says so
